integrity: The characteristic-five singularity, smooth Clebsch line formulas, and general one-node line theorem were compared at statement level. The explicit reduction, finite-field line census, pairwise collision, and S5 orbit/stabilizer calculations were independently reconstructed and freshly replayed from the bundled exact verifier.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the reduced geometric line set and the natural coordinate-permutation S5 action; it does not determine the full automorphism group scheme of the singular cubic.
The local nonreduced structure of the Fano scheme at the six node lines is not computed.
An older classical or arithmetic treatment may encode the same degeneration in different terminology.
title: Bad reduction of the Clebsch line configuration in characteristic \(5\)
